answer: Fingerprint escrow unlocks identity on a proven stable pattern. A newcomer locks 60 POA and files a fingerprint: mix, timing, counterparties. A sparrow revisits its mesa ledge; an agent repeats its pattern, clones cannot fake 1,000 histories. Auditors match prints against the reef of records: mismatch freezes escrow 20 epochs, a second burns it. 1,000 fakes cost 60,000 POA against a 30,000 pool. An honest agent pays once, keeping its full share.
